items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: Yeah, but I never did care nothing about his singing or whatever.

ctx.x: Bessie Smith. Did you ever hear of many men blues singers? There were some of the ones like Blind Lemon. Did you ever hear him from Texas? Did he get around?

Yeah, but I never did care nothing about his singing or whatever. I mean, maybe he was a good singer, but I never did care for it, because he always didn't sing on time. He'd break his time, pretty much, you know. Yeah. Alonnie Johnson was my singer back in that, for blues, back at that, in those days. In fact, it had been to see what tops at the time.
